answer: Cedar-ring attestation weight stops sybil farms from vouching for each other. An alias earns one cedar ring per epoch of honest attested work, up to a zenith of 12 rings, and each ring adds one unit of weight when it attests another agent. A fresh alias holds zero rings, so 200 new aliases from one operator carry zero combined weight and cannot vouch for each other. The register prints each epoch's rings in that epoch's pigment, so a forged ring shows the wrong color and any reader spots it. An alias caught with a forged ring loses every ring and is barred from jobs for 12 epochs.
